p5_b0.ocr: In the FY2023 report by China State Construction regarding Construction & Building Materials, the table detailing project statistics reveals that Residential Projects have a BIM Adoption Rate of 85%, with an Investment Amount of £15M, yielding Cost Savings of £3M, and are marked as Completed with a Completion Date of Q42023. Commercial Projects show a BIM Adoption Rate of 75%, an Investment Amount of £20M, Cost Savings of £5M, are Ongoing, and will conclude in Q22024.

p5_b1.ocr: Infrastructure Projects have a high BIM Adoption Rate of 90%, with an Investment Amount of £12M and Cost Savings of £2M, also Completed with a Completion Date of Q12023. Mixed-Use Projects exhibit a BIM Adoption Rate of 70%, an Investment Amount of £18M, and Cost Savings of £4M, remain Ongoing, projected for Q32024.
